More for leisurely sittings than a full lunch/dinner
Apr 2026 • Couples
I learned about this place from the blogger videos that praised it. This place is open on a buffet basis, only you prepare your own dishes. How it works: At the entrance, you pay a fixed amount per person, take a table and go to pick up groceries. About 80% of the food is raw, you cook it right at your desk, which has the grill embedded in it. There are ready meals in the restaurant, but they are quite few and quickly dismantled. Pros of the establishment: raw products are really abundant and they are different - there are fish of different kinds, seafood and frogs. There are also unlimited light drinks like Coke and Sprite, beer and ice cream. You can sit in a restaurant for an unlimited amount of time, which is important because cooking takes quite a long time. Cons: there are many foods you've never heard of, which means you don't know how to cook them and there's a good chance you'll eat raw food. The grill is quite powerful and the paper you need to cook on burns in minutes. The restaurant itself is located in a mall north of the centre of Nha Trang, so it is not possible to walk here. We came and went by taxi. 
My personal opinion is that if you're hungry or afraid to do something wrong, it's better to go to a regular restaurant. And this place you can come just to sit, drink beer, take your time to make some snacks and enjoy the view - it's just amazing here.
